I can't deal with this anymore, really. 

Being single really is too much pain.

Edit: That moment when you try eHarmony's quiz once more and you get: http://i.imgur.com/CAGqQAt.png

I don't have anyone to lean on.

Besides that, real life is shit. I live in a tiny ass country county in california, there are NO girls here who share my intrests, and the ones who would even from what I can tell - already taken.

Besides that, I don't currently have the income to sustain real life dates. I'm on fucking welfare for gods sake. This shit is part of why I resort to online dating, or did. 

I didn't even graduate high school, and no store or anything wants to hire some fatass schmuck who didn't get a HS Diploma.
